name: single_table_bound
sql: UPDATE repro_enum_target SET v=%s WHERE id=1

name: join_explicit_cast
sql: UPDATE repro_enum_target AS target JOIN repro_enum_stage AS incoming ON target.id=incoming.id SET target.v=CAST(incoming.v AS CHAR)

name: rename_incoming_column
sql: UPDATE repro_enum_target AS target JOIN (SELECT id,v AS incoming_value FROM repro_enum_stage) AS incoming ON target.id=incoming.id SET target.v=incoming.incoming_value
